case_number: 2024 INSC 970; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 14328/2024 @ SLP (CIVIL) NO. 27723 OF 2024
summary: Compromise decree enforcement; statutory remedy of restoration under Order 23 Rule 3 CPC; High Court's denial of liberty to restore appeal invalid; consent decree without liberty clause cannot preclude statutory remedy; compromise voidable due to dishonored cheques; recall not required for restoration; validity of consent decree as estoppel examined.
legal_provisions_cited: Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 Order 23 Rule 3
Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 Order 23 Rule 3A
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; restoration of appeal permitted; High Court's dismissal of restoration application set aside; appellant entitled to statutory remedy under Order 23 Rule 3 CPC.
